lead: Use for work judged by eye or ear (a render, an image, an animation, a sound), and for a web front end held to the person's design system. Look work: what will prove it is said before the first change, each change is checked by measured shots, defects are fixed, and taste is left to the owner. A front end: one system for every repo, a pin, and a check that fails on anything off-system.

define-success.cue: about to start, or nothing says what will prove it

iterate.cue: a change is being made and checked: a few proving shots

judge.cue: a difference needs a verdict, or taste waits for the owner

probe.cue: a colour, shape, or timing differs and the cause is unknown

calibrate.cue: a gate fails on something untouched, or numbers wobble

motion.cue: what a still cannot show: animation, smoothness, a clip

audio.cue: sound is produced or changed, or must stay in sync

shot-harness.cue: no .agents/perceptual/ folder, or no shot renders on command

system.cue: declare or see the one design system your front ends use

adopt.cue: a web front end is not yet on the design system

check.cue: front-end work in a pinned repo, or the design check fails
